fra_philip_vi_valois.en: Philip VI of France (1293–1350), called the Fortunate, was the first [ShowDynastyName('valois_dynasty')] king, chosen by the nobles and tested by that choice for the rest of his life. His father [GetCharacter('fra_charles_valois').GetName] had struggled for the throne and never won it; in 1328, when the last Capetian, [GetCharacter('fra_charles_iv_capet').GetName], died, the nobility preferred Charles's paternal cousin Philip to his nephew through his sister, [GetCharacter('eng_edward_iii').GetName] of England. Philip opened with victory at [ShowLocationName('cassel')] in 1328, restoring the Count of Flanders. Relations with Edward soured over Aquitaine and Philip's backing of David II of Scotland, and in 1337 Philip declared Aquitaine forfeit. Edward answered by claiming the French crown: the Hundred Years' War had begun. His fleet was destroyed at Sluys in 1340; at Crécy in 1346 he ordered a general attack as evening fell, and barely escaped as his army was annihilated. [ShowLocationName('calais')] fell in 1347. The Black Death then killed Queen Joan and a third of the population. He bought the Dauphiné in 1349 and died on 22 August 1350, leaving a divided kingdom to his son [GetCharacter('fra_jean_ii_valois').GetName].
fra_philip_vi_valois.zh: 腓力六世（1293—1350），绰号幸运者，是[ShowDynastyName('valois_dynasty')]王朝的第一位国王，由贵族推举为王，此后一生都在为这一选择付出代价。他的父亲[GetCharacter('fra_charles_valois').GetName]争夺王位而未能如愿；1328年末代卡佩国王[GetCharacter('fra_charles_iv_capet').GetName]去世，法国贵族选择了查理的父系堂兄腓力，而不是查理的外甥英王[GetCharacter('eng_edward_iii').GetName]。腓力即位之初在1328年的[ShowLocationName('cassel')]大胜，使佛兰德伯爵复位。他与爱德华因阿基坦问题，以及腓力支持苏格兰国王大卫二世而日渐交恶；1337年，腓力宣布没收阿基坦。爱德华以主张法兰西王位作为回应，百年战争由此爆发。他的舰队于1340年在斯勒伊斯覆灭；1346年在克雷西，他在傍晚下令全军进攻，军队被歼灭，他本人勉强脱身。[ShowLocationName('calais')]于1347年陷落。随后黑死病夺走了王后让娜和三分之一的人口。他于1349年购得多菲内，1350年8月22日去世，把一个分裂的王国留给儿子[GetCharacter('fra_jean_ii_valois').GetName]。

eng_edward_iii.en: Edward III (1312–1377) was crowned king of [GetCountry('ENG').GetName] at fourteen in 1327, after his mother Isabella and her ally Roger Mortimer forced his father [GetCharacter('eng_edward_ii').GetName] from the throne. In October 1330 Edward and a few trusted men, among them William Montagu, surprised Mortimer at [ShowLocationName('nottingham')] Castle and began the king's personal rule. He backed Edward Balliol's claim to Scotland and won at Halidon Hill in 1333. When [GetCharacter('fra_philip_vi_valois').GetName] confiscated Gascony in 1337, Edward answered by claiming the French crown through his mother, opening the Hundred Years' War after creating six new earls in a single day. His fleet destroyed a French fleet at Sluys on 24 June 1340. At Crécy on 26 August 1346 his army beat a far larger French force, and Calais fell on 3 August 1347 after a siege of almost a year. In 1356 the Black Prince won at Poitiers and captured King John II, and in 1360 the Treaty of Brétigny gave Edward his French lands in full sovereignty in return for giving up the French crown. The Black Death of 1348 killed a third or more of the English; his Statute of Labourers of 1351 tried to freeze wages. He founded the Order of the Garter around 1348, made his sons the first English dukes, and relied on Parliament for the taxes his wars cost, which strengthened the Commons; in 1362 English was ordered into the law courts. The chronicler Froissart wrote that his like had not been seen since King Arthur. War resumed in 1369, and by 1375 he had lost all but the Calais Pale. In his last years government passed to John of Gaunt. The Black Prince died before him, and Edward died of a stroke at Sheen on 21 June 1377. His grandson Richard II succeeded him.
eng_edward_iii.zh: 爱德华三世（1312—1377）于1327年十四岁时加冕为[GetCountry('ENG').GetName]国王：此前，他的母亲伊莎贝拉与盟友罗杰·莫蒂默逼迫他的父亲[GetCharacter('eng_edward_ii').GetName]退位。1330年10月，爱德华带着包括威廉·蒙塔古在内的少数亲信，在[ShowLocationName('nottingham')]城堡出其不意地拿下莫蒂默，开始亲政。他支持爱德华·巴里奥对苏格兰王位的要求，1333年在哈利顿山取胜。1337年法王[GetCharacter('fra_philip_vi_valois').GetName]没收加斯科涅，爱德华以母系血统主张法国王位作为回应，并在同一天册封六位新伯爵，百年战争由此开始。1340年6月24日，他的舰队在斯勒伊斯击毁法国舰队。1346年8月26日，他的军队在克雷西击败兵力远胜于己的法军；1347年8月3日，加来在围困近一年后陷落。1356年，黑太子在普瓦捷获胜并俘虏法王约翰二世；1360年的《布雷蒂尼条约》使爱德华完全主权地保有法国领地，条件是放弃对法国王位的要求。1348年的黑死病夺走了三分之一以上的英格兰人口，他于1351年颁布《劳工法令》，试图冻结工资。约1348年，他创立嘉德骑士团，封自己的儿子们为英格兰最早的公爵，战争的税款有赖议会批准，下议院因此壮大；1362年，法庭改用英语。编年史家傅华萨写道，自亚瑟王以来再没有人能与他相比。1369年战争重启，到1375年，除加来周边地区外，他在法国的领地尽数丧失。晚年大权落入冈特的约翰之手。黑太子先他去世，1377年6月21日，爱德华中风死于希恩，孙子理查二世继位。

yua_togon_temur.en: Toghon Temür (25 May 1320–23 May 1370), temple name Emperor Huizong, was the last Yuan emperor to rule China and the first of the Northern Yuan. Eldest son of [GetCharacter('yua_khutughtu').GetName], Emperor Mingzong, he was born during his father's exile in Central Asia, and after his father died in suspicious circumstances he was himself banished to Goryeo and then Guangxi. When his brother Rinchinbal died in 1332, the minister El Temür, suspected of involvement in Mingzong's death, delayed his enthronement for some six months, until 1333. For years ministers ruled in his name. Bayan purged the court and suspended the civil service examinations, until in 1340 the emperor removed him with the help of Bayan's nephew Toqto'a, who restored the examinations. The Zhizheng era began in 1341, and the official histories of the Liao, Jin and Song were finished in 1345. It also produced the dated blue-and-white “David Vases” of 1351. But floods, famine and a falling currency undermined the court, and the Red Turban Rebellion of 1351 broke Yuan power; in 1354 the emperor dismissed Toqto'a. He withdrew from governing while warlords fought over the capital, and in 1365 he raised his Korean consort Lady Gi to first empress. He was a patron of [ShowReligionName('tibetan_buddhism')] and studied under successive Karmapas. After 35 years on the throne, the longest Yuan reign after Kublai Khan, he fled [ShowLocationName('dadu')] at midnight in September 1368 as Xu Da's Ming army closed in, and the city fell days later. On the steppe his court, the Northern Yuan, kept claiming the imperial title. Mongolian chronicles preserve a poem in which he mourns the lost capital. He died at [ShowLocationName('yingchang')] in 1370 and was succeeded by his son Ayushiridara.
yua_togon_temur.zh: 妥懽帖睦尔（1320年5月25日—1370年5月23日），庙号惠宗，是元朝在中原的末代皇帝，也是北元的第一位皇帝。他是元明宗[GetCharacter('yua_khutughtu').GetName]的长子，生于父亲流亡中亚期间，父亲死于可疑的情形后，他自己也先后被流放高丽和广西。1332年弟弟懿璘质班去世，被怀疑与明宗之死有关的权臣燕帖木儿把他的即位拖延了约六个月，直到1333年他才登基。此后多年大权由权臣把持。伯颜清洗朝臣，停罢科举；1340年皇帝借伯颜之侄脱脱之力将他罢黜，脱脱恢复了科举。1341年改元至正，1345年辽、金、宋三史修成。至正年间还烧制出1351年有纪年的青花“大维德瓶”。但水患、饥荒和钞法败坏动摇了朝廷，1351年红巾军起义打垮了元朝的统治；1354年皇帝罢免了脱脱。此后他渐渐不再亲理朝政，军阀在大都一带争战，1365年他把高丽籍的奇氏立为第一皇后。他信奉[ShowReligionName('tibetan_buddhism')]，师从历代噶玛巴。他在位35年，是忽必烈之后在位最久的元朝皇帝；1368年9月，徐达的明军逼近，他在半夜出[ShowLocationName('dadu')]北逃，数日后大都陷落。在草原上，他的朝廷即北元，继续主张皇帝名号。蒙古编年史保存着一首诗，诗中他哀悼失去的都城。他于1370年卒于[ShowLocationName('yingchang')]，由儿子爱猷识理达腊继位。

chg_timur_lame_borjigin.en: Timur (1336–1405), known to Europeans as Tamerlane, was a Turco-Mongol conqueror from Transoxiana who founded the Timurid Empire. He was born near Kesh, now Shahrisabz, some 80 kilometres south of Samarkand, into the Turkified [ShowCultureName('mongolian_culture')] Barlas tribe, the son of a minor noble named [GetCharacter('chg_taraghai_noyan_borjigin').GetName]; his name Temur means iron. Around 1363 two arrows struck him in the leg and the right hand, in one account as he tried to steal a sheep, and he was lame for life: the Persian Temur-i Lang, Timur the Lame, is the origin of Tamerlane. Because he was not descended from Genghis Khan he could not take the title of khan, so he ruled as emir in the name of a puppet Chagatai khan and married into the Chinggisid line to be called güregen, royal son-in-law. By 1370 he held the western Chagatai Khanate, and from Samarkand he conquered Persia, defeated Tokhtamysh of the Golden Horde in 1395, sacked Delhi in 1398 and crushed the Ottomans at Ankara on 20 July 1402, where Sultan Bayezid was taken prisoner. He styled himself Sahib Qiran, Lord of Conjunction, and Sword of Islam, and kings from Henry III of Castile to Charles VI of France sent embassies or praise; yet Baghdad, Damascus and Delhi were sacked, and scholars estimate his wars killed millions. In December 1404 he set out against Ming China in winter, fell ill beyond the Syr Darya and died at Farab in February 1405. He was buried in the Gur-e-Amir at [ShowLocationName('samarkand')]. His empire fragmented soon after, but his grandson Ulugh Beg ruled Central Asia in 1411–1449, and his descendant Babur founded the Mughal Empire.
chg_timur_lame_borjigin.zh: 帖木儿（1336—1405），欧洲人称塔梅尔兰，是出身河中地区的突厥—蒙古征服者，帖木儿帝国的建立者。他生于撒马尔罕以南约80公里的渴石（今沙赫里萨布兹）附近，属于已经突厥化的[ShowCultureName('mongolian_culture')]巴鲁剌思部落，是小贵族[GetCharacter('chg_taraghai_noyan_borjigin').GetName]之子；“帖木儿”一名意为铁。约1363年，他的腿和右手各中一箭，有一种说法是在偷羊时中箭，从此终身跛足：波斯语的“帖木儿·朗”即跛子帖木儿，是“塔梅尔兰”一名的由来。由于不是成吉思汗的后裔，他不能称汗，只能以埃米尔的身份，奉一位傀儡察合台汗之名执政，并娶成吉思汗家族的公主，号称“古列干”，即皇家驸马。到1370年他已掌控西察合台汗国，此后以撒马尔罕为基地征服波斯，1395年击败金帐汗脱脱迷失，1398年洗劫德里，1402年7月20日在安卡拉击溃奥斯曼军队，苏丹巴耶济德一世被俘。他自称“萨希布·基兰”（合相之主）和“伊斯兰之剑”，从卡斯蒂利亚的亨利三世到法王查理六世，欧洲君主纷纷遣使或称颂他；但巴格达、大马士革和德里都遭劫掠，学者估计他的战争夺去了数百万人的生命。1404年12月，他在冬季出兵攻明，在锡尔河对岸病倒，1405年2月死于法拉卜，葬于[ShowLocationName('samarkand')]的古尔·埃米尔陵。他的帝国此后不久便告分裂，但其孙兀鲁伯于1411至1449年统治中亚，其后裔巴布尔建立了莫卧儿帝国。

fra_charles_iv_capet.en: Charles IV, called the Fair (1294–1328), third son of #TOOLTIP:CHARACTER,fra_philippe_iv_capet Philip IV#!, ruled #TOOLTIP:COUNTRY,FRA France#! and Navarre from 1322, the last king of the direct Capetian line. His first wife Blanche of Burgundy was disgraced in the Tour de Nesle affair of 1314 and their marriage was annulled. From 1323 he faced a peasant revolt in Flanders, and in 1324 his bid for the imperial crown failed. That year his troops overran English-held Guyenne in the War of Saint-Sardos. In the ensuing peace #TOOLTIP:CHARACTER,eng_edward_ii Edward II#! accepted homage and a fine, recovering a reduced Guyenne. Charles died in 1328 leaving no son; France passed to his cousin #TOOLTIP:CHARACTER,fra_philip_vi_valois Philip of Valois#! and Navarre to his niece Joan II. The French succession dispute fed the Hundred Years' War.
fra_charles_iv_capet.zh: “美男子”查理四世（1294—1328）是#TOOLTIP:CHARACTER,fra_philippe_iv_capet 腓力四世#!第三子，1322年起统治#TOOLTIP:COUNTRY,FRA 法兰西#!与纳瓦拉，也是卡佩嫡系的末代国王。他的第一任妻子勃艮第的布朗奇卷入1314年的内斯勒塔事件，二人婚姻被废除。1323年起他面临佛兰德农民起义，1324年竞选神圣罗马帝位失败。同年，他的军队在圣萨尔多战争中攻占英格兰人据有的吉耶讷公国。随后的和约中，#TOOLTIP:CHARACTER,eng_edward_ii 爱德华二世#!同意向他效忠并缴纳罚金，换回了领土缩小的吉耶讷。1328年查理去世时没有留下男嗣，法兰西王位传给堂弟#TOOLTIP:CHARACTER,fra_philip_vi_valois 瓦卢瓦的腓力#!，纳瓦拉王位归侄女胡安娜二世。法国王位的继承纠纷后来成为百年战争的导火索。
